spec: METHODOLOGY §1.3 contested-data exclusion list. Every entry carries a justification. generate_bank.mjs applies these on top of frame eligibility.

exclusions.justification: Venezuela's Class-C macro aggregates for 2018-2022 (GDP levels and growth, debt, fiscal and external balances, FDI ratios) span a hyperinflation and reporting breakdown in which official figures are disputed and heavily model-imputed; grading recall against them measures politics, not memory (METHODOLOGY §1.3).
